summary: Closest to home, the University of Arizona Cancer Center in Tucson is an NCI Comprehensive Cancer Center in your state. Duke Sarcoma Center has a dedicated sarcoma program page, but it is out of state, so the Beat the Odds travel grant and the Sarcoma Foundation of America trial travel reimbursement are worth looking at. The program pages found do not show intake contacts, so the next step is to call each program's main line and ask about new-patient intake and records requirements. Final eligibility for any study is decided by the study team.
